app.title: Cloudflare Turnstile solver library (no headless browser required)
app.author: costco
app.description: A Python library to programmatically solve Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHAs without using a headless browser.
proposed_tests: Run a sample script to request a Turnstile token against a test site
Measure success rate and latency compared to a browser-based approach
Verify the library handles token expiry and retries
